deadline.value: Priority deadline is December 15; applications are reviewed through March 20.
deadline.quote: Our priority deadline for evaluation of applications is December 15. | Applications will continue to be reviewed through March 20.

gre_general.value: The department does not require the GRE.
gre_general.quote: Applicants do not need to take the GRE exam or report GRE scores to be considered for PhD, MS or MA admission

gre_subject.value: The department does not require the GRE, including the Chemistry subject test.
gre_subject.quote: Applicants do not need to take the GRE exam or report GRE scores to be considered for PhD, MS or MA admission

toefl_min.value: The department's TOEFL iBT minimum is 79, the same as the university.

ielts_min.value: IELTS 6.5 overall with no Speaking sub-score below 6 is the department's equivalent of TOEFL 79.
ielts_min.quote: equal to an IELTS (International English Language Testing System) score of 6.5 overall

fee_waiver.value: The department is not offering fee waivers at this time.
fee_waiver.quote: At this time we are not offering any fee waivers.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided on the whole application; students choose an advisor after their first year.
supervisor.quote: TOEFL scores alone do not guarantee admission, applications are considered in their entirety.

also.quote: The choice of research advisors normally occurs by December 15 to enable the student to begin his/her research effort during the Winter Session of his/her first year

funding.value: Full-time PhD students who are cleared to TA receive a stipend and tuition waiver.
funding.quote: All full-time Ph.D. students who are cleared to TA receive a generous stipend and tuition waiver

entry_route.value: The department pages do not say whether a bachelor's or a master's is needed to enter.

notes: Department sets its own priority (December 15) and final (March 20) dates; spring has August 31 and September 30.
